incidents.name: NblNftStake withdrawNft reentrancy
incidents.notes: NblNftStake.withdrawNft() returned the staked ERC-721 with safeTransferFrom before clearing the slot's NBL accounting and carried no reentrancy guard, so the onERC721Received callback re-entered depositNft/depositNbl and withdrew the contract's whole NBL balance.

sources.ref: onchain review: NblNftStake 0x5499178919C79086fd580d6c5f332a4253244D91 created 2024-01-15T01:29:55Z by 0xcea80f944a0b90e62adbd2999c89d27e39e51c73, not the attack-tx sender 0x1fd0a6a5e232eeba8020a40535ad07013ec4ef12; no EIP-1967 events, 10.4 days old. The PoC comment marks withdrawNft as the flawed function with no reentrancy protection. Reported loss ~$180k.
